messages:
Alyssa: quick check — canary v2.3.0 rolled at 02:10 UTC. p50 looks fine but p99 jumped ~22% vs baseline on llm-small. sample numbers: p50 120ms -> 125ms, p99 880ms -> 1076ms. Can we decide hold/rollback? @Kevin @Maria
Kevin: looking now. do we have a perf histogram or a trace? any error spike alongside latency?
Alyssa: posted histogram here: https://internal.perf/canary/1937 — error rate small bump 0.2% -> 0.9%, mostly latency. rollout currently at 10%.
Kevin: starting quick probe. running light flame + kernel breakdown.
Maria: my initial rule: if p99 > +15% OR errors > 0.5% sustained for 30m -> rollback. otherwise pause and profile. also check KV cache miss rate and inter-node variance.
Kevin: probe command I'm using:
```bash
tools/profiler/run_probe --canary-id=canary-1937 --span=10m --metrics latency,kernel,kv_miss --out=flame_1937.svg
```
ci-bot: Perf probe triggered for canary-1937, results ETA ~6m.
Kevin: flamegraph looks like attention kernel spends more time on some hosts. kernel fallback to fp32 appears on a subset of nodes. tagging @infra-team
Alyssa: infra reported one node on driver 535.x while rest are 540.x — suspected mismatch causing fallback on that node.
infra-team: confirmed. scheduling a quick driver patch to match 540.x on the cohort. will patch the 10% group and re-run probe.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused at 10% by manual hold (no rollback triggered).
Maria: decision: pause rollout and apply driver fix to the 10% cohort, then re-run two perf probes. If p99 remains > +15% after those runs -> rollback. I approve the pause. :thumbsup:
Alyssa: ack. I'll coordinate the patch and ping when the re-run completes. thanks everyone.
